mapper.insert:
insert into employee_attendance( emp_attendance_no, contract_no, work_date, clock_in, clock_out, break_minutes, attendance_type,
night_hours, overtime_hours ) values( #{empAttendanceNo}, #{contractNo}, #{workDate}, #{clockIn}, #{clockOut}, #{breakMinutes}, #{attendanceType},
#{nightHours}, #{overtimeHours} )
mapper.update:
update employee_attendance
clock_in = null, clock_out = null, break_minutes = 0, attendance_type = #{attendanceType}, night_hours = 0, overtime_hours = 0,
clock_in = #{clockIn}, clock_out = #{clockOut}, break_minutes = #{breakMinutes}, attendance_type = #{attendanceType},
night_hours = #{nightHours}, overtime_hours = #{overtimeHours},
where emp_attendance_no = #{empAttendanceNo}
mapper.select:
select E.employee_no, E.account_no, A.account_id, A.account_name
from employee E
inner join account A on A.account_no = E.account_no
where A.account_no = #{accountNo}

select E.employee_no, E.account_no, A.account_id, A.account_name
from employee E
inner join account A on A.account_no = E.account_no
where E.employee_no = #{employeeNo}
select A.* from employee_attendance A inner join employee_work_schedule S on A.contract_no = S.contract_no and A.work_date = S.scheduled_work_date where S.work_schedule_no = #{workScheduleNo}
mapper.update: UPDATE attendance SET attendance_state = '결석', attendance_at = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE class_session_no = #{sessionNo} AND attendance_state = '미출결'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO attendance ( attendance_no, class_session_no, student_no, attendance_state ) SELECT attendance_seq.nextval, #{sessionNo}, r.student_no, '미출결' FROM registration r WHERE r.course_no = #{courseNo}
mapper.update: update attendance set attendance_state = #{attendanceState}, attendance_at = SYSTIMESTAMP where attendance_no = #{attendanceNo}
mapper.select: select c.employee_no from attendance a join class_session cs on a.class_session_no = cs.session_no join schedule sc on cs.schedule_no = sc.schedule_no join course c on sc.course_no = c.course_no where a.attendance_no = #{attendanceNo}

SELECT a.attendance_no AS attendanceNo, a.student_no AS studentNo, acc.account_name AS studentName, acc.account_phone AS studentPhone, a.attendance_state AS attendanceState, a.attendance_at AS attendanceAt FROM attendance a JOIN student s ON a.student_no = s.student_no JOIN account acc ON s.account_no = acc.account_no WHERE a.class_session_no = #{sessionNo} ORDER BY acc.account_name ASC
